purpose: Accept evidence-bound Visual Makeover proposal drafts as PromptOS governance input without inheriting browser or execution authority.
runtimeTruthRule: Repository acceptance proves only that PromptOS knows how to validate the handoff shape. It does not prove a live Visual Makeover runtime, provider connection, browser session, publication, or external outcome.
authorityRule: Accepted handoff content is advisory input. PromptOS cannot widen browser, repository, provider, deployment, publication, spending, or mutation authority.
rollback: Revert this focused PromptOS acceptance contract and verifier. No provider, browser, authentication, cookie, or user-data rollback is required.
